text:
maria (Design): Quick design sync — posting screenshots of the new Latency panel. Main ask: decide where the p95 metric, heatmap, time-range presets, and sampling controls live. Current mock has p95 large left, heatmap right, sampling toggle in the header. Thoughts?

jake (PM): overall 👍. Are we keeping per-route drop-down in the same row as presets? worried about vertical space.

samir (Eng): performance note: rendering the full heatmap at 1s buckets kills CPU on 100k rows. We should default to downsampled buckets and expose a "high-res" toggle. Also the sampling control needs to map to server-side rate limit, not just client-side UI apperance.

eli (Frontend): agree with Samir. UX suggestion: collapse sampling into an overflow menu with a 3-state control: Off / Smart-sample / Full. Labels: "Off" vs "Smart (default)" vs "Full (costly)" — avoid jargon.

aisha (A11y): contrast nits: thin gray separator between p95 card and heatmap fails AA on small screens. Also sampling toggle icons need accessible labels and focus outlines. Keyboard order currently goes: presets -> heatmap -> p95, should be presets -> p95 -> heatmap for screen readers.

maria (Design): good call. What about moving sampling into the presets row: small link "Sampling: Smart" that opens a panel? keeps header cleaner.

samir (Eng): fine. Implementation detail: server-side sampling config name = `sampling_profile` (we discussed). Example payload:

``
PATCH /dashboards/:id
{
  "panels": [{
    "id": "latency-1",
    "sampling_profile": "smart"
  }]
}
``

Front-end should send only enum values: `off|smart|full`.

eli (Frontend): microcopy suggestion for the inline explainer: "Smart sampling reduces detail for low-traffic routes to improve performance — toggle to Full for exact counts." shorten to: "Smart sampling balances accuracy and cost — use Full for exact traces."

aisha (A11y): wording tweak: "Full" -> "High fidelity" for clarity to screen readers. "Full" can be ambiguous.

jake (PM): product tradeoff: if default is Smart we should surface an inline CTA: "Show exact counts" that temporarily expands high-res for the view period — avoids surprise costs.

maria (Design): UX flow: clicking "Show exact counts" should open a confirmation tooltip: "This view may increase query cost. Continue? [Confirm] [Cancel]". Also add an info icon with `aria-describedby` linking to a small explainer dialog.

samir (Eng): backend will enforce a 60s rate-limit on Full mode and emit a warning event for billing. We should show a transient banner: "High-fidelity view may incur extra cost — see billing docs" with a link.

eli (Frontend): accessibility implement note: use `role="dialog"` for the explainer, trap focus, and restore focus on close. For the sampling link add `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.

deploy-bot: CI:lint passed for `latency-panel` branch — includes initial heatmap component.

maria (Design): I'll update the mock: move sampling into presets row as a compact link, change copy to "Sampling: Smart (High fidelity available)" and add the confirm modal microcopy per above. Will ping for another quick pass tomorrow. :sparkles:

jake (PM): thanks — add acceptance criteria: keyboard navigable, color contrast AA, and server enum mapping `off|smart|high_fidelity`.

aisha (A11y): I'll run an axe pass once the branch is up. :white_check_mark:
